reading.body:
DC BLOX operates this Chattanooga facility as one of 23 sites in its regional network, though the operator publishes no megawatt figure specific to this location. Across Tennessee, this site ranks fifth by published capacity among four facilities that disclose power figures, but the state context reflects only 12.13 MW of published capacity across all mapped data centers in Tennessee, making statewide disclosure sparse.

The facility's power capacity is not published. Without a disclosed megawatt figure or square footage broken to this address, no calculation of rack or accelerator density is possible from the operator's own specifications.

This Chattanooga location appears in the operator's facility map with a verified street address but no performance certification, redundancy rating, or grid connection details in the published record. The operator's company-wide aggregate of 470 MW across 23 facilities averages 20 MW per site, which would suggest an indicative range only, not a confirmed figure for this location.
